about_the_game:
Legends of Azamar is a fast-paced action RPG focused on loot, dungeon crawling, and visceral combat. Answer the call of Tag Lodahn, a dwarven mining town now overwhelmed by relentless incursions. Driven by glory, treasure, or duty, descend into the depths, battle deadly foes, and uncover the secrets that lie below.

Classes

Battle through the depths as the mighty Warrior, the cunning Rogue, or the enigmatic Mage, each wielding unique weapons, abilities, and play styles. Adapt, experiment, and uncover the legends buried deep within!

Dungeon Crawling Action

Legends of Azamar is an ARPG condensed to its core. Descend, fight, loot, return to camp, and repeat. Face increasingly deadly challenges as you push deeper, growing stronger with each expedition, culminating in brutal boss fights!

Replayability

Do you have the courage to face Tag Lodahn's ever-shifting depths? Each expedition will never be the same with procedurally generated dungeons, dynamic paths, quests, and unique items to collect.

Choose your Path

Build your character with legendary equipment, powerful passives, and devastating abilities. Shape your path with six unique passive skill trees, each offering new avenues of character customisation. Will you become an unbreakable juggernaut by following the path of the Tower? Or embrace the Serpent’s cunning, and strike with lethal poisons? Or will you walk your own path?

content_descriptors.notes: Legends of Azamar may contain content not appropriate for all ages. This game includes: frequent violence or gore against fantasy characters, general mature content, and elements of horror

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 3770
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Additional Notes: These specs allow for the game to run at 1080p with 30fps

short_description: Step into the world of Avendor and brave the caverns of Tag Lodahn, a dwarven mining town overrun by restless invaders. Descend into ever-shifting depths, grow in power, and claim legendary loot as you uncover the legends of Azamar in this visceral loot-driven action RPG.
